title: Customer numbers
description: Customer panel numbers that changed hands: number changes and reports made by the people, reassignment notices processed here, and numbers whose history was closed because they were not confirmed for a long time.
forbidden: You are not allowed to view customer numbers.
empty_description: A number that changes hands appears here.
form.title: Reassignment notice
form.description: Process a number that was given to someone else, learned from an operator notice or a support request.
form.effects_title: The notice is processed at once
form.effect_history: The number's profile no longer sees bookings made before today at any business. Nothing is deleted at the businesses.
form.effect_sessions: Every panel session of the profile ends.
form.effect_records: Records of the number found later open only bookings made from now on.
form.note_hint: Where the notice came from, e.g. an operator letter or a support ticket number.
form.note_too_long: The note can be at most 500 characters.
confirm.title: Process the notice?
confirm.description: The number's profile loses sight of its earlier bookings and every session of it ends. This cannot be undone.
toast.processed: Notice processed: history hidden at {{businesses}} businesses, {{sessions}} sessions ended.
toast.processed_no_profile: Notice processed. The number has no Takwim profile; records found later will not open earlier history.
errors.already_released: Nobody confirmed this number since it last changed hands; there is nothing new to process.
